constraints.name: uniform_range
constraints.description: All monks share the same enlightenment value (range) that must be minimized.
constraints.formal: r_1 = r_2 = ... = r_K = r, minimize r

constraints.name: range_integer
constraints.description: The enlightenment value is an integer.

constraints.name: complete_coverage
constraints.description: All N temples must be covered by the enlightenment ranges of the monks.

constraints.name: fixed_num_monks
constraints.description: Exactly K monks are available to be placed.

constraints.name: continuous_placement
constraints.description: Each monk can be placed at any real coordinate on the line.

constraints.name: monks_less_than_temples
constraints.description: The number of monks is strictly less than the number of temples, ensuring a non-trivial minimum range.
